events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being its first broadcast video.

angles.name: Impact of MTV
angles.copy: Remember when MTV actually played music videos? On this day in 1981, the channel launched, forever changing the music landscape. What was the first video you ever saw on MTV that blew you away?

events.title: Oasis released Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 29 years ago today, Oasis unleashed 'Definitely Maybe' on the world. An album that defined a generation and launched one of Britain's biggest bands. Which track is still on repeat for you?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Spirit of Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off. More than just a music event, it was a cultural phenomenon. If you could have been there, which artist would you have seen?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, in 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll. On this day, we reflect on the incredible legacy of Elvis Presley, whose music continues to influence generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, dying several days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas in 1996. His lyrics and message continue to resonate. What's his most enduring track for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Jimi Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From that legendary cover to timeless tracks, it's an album that still sounds fresh. What's your standout song?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders have always been unmistakable. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Love him or... well, you know the rest. What's your favourite Liam moment, musical or otherwise?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007 since 'Dr. No' premiered in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and vision of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: No silly walks here, just a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, he's a true comedy legend. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles released The White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album' – a sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track from the double LP is your absolute favourite?
